source_text: Long-term effects, confirmed in systematic reviews and meta-analyses, encompass chronic urinary tract infections, menstrual difficulties, keloid scar formation, decreased sexual function, and obstetric risks such as prolonged labor and higher neonatal mortality (with odds ratios up to 1.55 for perinatal death in Type III cases).
